---
title: smalldocs 0.5.2
subtitle: Captions and fixes in the Markdown copies
date: 2026-10-21
author: Rahul Dave
categories: [release]
image: ../images/mark.svg
---

A notebook's picture with `fig-cap` now has its caption in the Markdown copy, in a
`<div class="figure-caption">` after the picture. Its `fig-alt` is the picture's alt text.

This release also fixes the copies:

- A cell hidden on the page is hidden in the copy, also in a list item or a quote.
- Text hidden with `when-format="llms-txt"` stays hidden after `<!--` in a code span.
- A notebook's attached picture is saved only when the copy shows its cell.
- A page with no `title:` has its first heading once, not twice.
